newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale Des Eaux sees 1996 net at 1.8 billion French francs.
newsitem.headline: Generale Des Eaux sees 1996 net at 1.8 billion French francs.

text.p: Generale Des Eaux will post 1996 net profit of about 1.8 billion francs ($347.6 million) after a net loss the year before of 3.69 billion francs, company chairman Jean-Marie Messier said on Monday.
Messier said the results would be "strongly marked by exceptional items, notably capital gains from asset sales".
He said the company's operating profit would be close to the 3.7 billion franc profit recorded in 1994.
Turnover in 1996 should be up three percent to 164 billion francs he added. ($ = 5.178 French Francs)
